title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades .Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

Responsabilidades:

  • Criar análises e relatórios a partir de diferentes fontes de dados, com foco em gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Construir e manter modelos de dados eficientes (camadas analíticas, camada semantica, views, data marts).
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como DBT, SQL, Python e ambientes como BigQuery ou Redshift.
  • Criar e documentar transformações de dados com boas práticas de versionamento e testes.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, analistas e product managers para garantir dados confiáveis.
  • Desenvolver dashboards (ex: Metabase, Looker) para visualização de métricas e KPIs.
  • Apoiar a criação de pequenos modelos preditivos ou análises estatísticas simples quando necessário.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de transformação de dados como DBT ou equivalente.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises exploratórias e criar relatórios com storytelling.
  • Noções de Python para análises e automações básicas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto e negócio: entender o\ "porquê\" por trás dos dados.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de versionamento e qualidade de dados.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Experiência com modelos preditivos simples (ex: churn, scoring, clustering).
  • Experiência em ambientes com DataOps ou MLOps.
  • Conhecimento em testes de dados (ex: dbt tests, Great Expectations).
  • Experiência explorando e analisando dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, entendendo as demandas do negócio por meio de conversas com stakeholders.
  • Vivência traduzindo os resultados por meio de relatórios e dashboards em ferramentas como Looker ou Metabase.

Modelo de Contratação: PJ

Oferecemos:

  • Ajuda de custo para o remoto;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade detrabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique pelo LinkedIn

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
    experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
    Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.

Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements .

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

If you're passionate about Web3, AI, and investing, and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we'd love to connect.

title: Senior Backend (Node.Js) Engineer
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli,XILOset out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that's at the forefront of AI innovation.About The Role As aSenior Backend Engineer, you'll bedesigning and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and buildingnew microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn't just another engineering role.We're solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space –problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we're building isn't just an upgrade – it's afundamental shift in how agencies operate .What You'll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO's platform. You'll have theopportunity to work where your strengths shineand contribute to: AI Agents– Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing– Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping– Aggregating and linking all relevant data into acentralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM– TheAI-powered backboneof agencies, seamlesslytracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflowswhile replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry– ATypeform-like systembuilt for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions –fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.What we're looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons.Why Join XILO? A great tech startup– Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth– Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing– Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCsKindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Operations Director

title: Product Owner Sênior
description: Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais. Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia. Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação. Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados. Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais. Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto. Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos. Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis. Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese. Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais. Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário. Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto. Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares. Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos. Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais. Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada. Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog. Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders. Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia. Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico, agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais. Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde. Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade. Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais. Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde. Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.Competências esperadas Forte senso de dono sobre o produto Excelente capacidade de priorização Visão de negócio com foco no usuário Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável Escuta ativa e boa facilitação Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto Alto nível de autonomia e accountabilityO que esperamos de sucesso nessa posiçãoO roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde. Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia. Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia. As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário. A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.Diferencial importante Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.

We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.

What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.

This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.

Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.

How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Professor De Inglês
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep, you read that right. Apply now!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The client is looking to build and scale advanced AI-powered solutions leveraging Generative AI technologies. The project focuses on designing and implementing intelligent systems using LLMs and agentic workflows to enhance business processes and deliver high-impact, scalable products.

General information

They are seeking a senior-level AI Engineer with strong experience in Generative AI and system architecture. The ideal candidate will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable GenAI solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and multi-agent architectures.

This role requires both hands-on technical expertise and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Task and Deliverables

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Design and implement GenAI-based systems (LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, fine-tuning)
  • Build and orchestrate agentic workflows, including multi-agent systems and tool integrations
  • Develop scalable APIs and microservices to support AI-driven applications
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, including cloud-based integrations (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Establish evaluation frameworks to measure performance (accuracy, latency, cost)
  • Continuously optimize models and systems through feedback loops and iteration
  • Provide regular updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, and deliverables

Required Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering)
  • Solid understanding of AI system architecture and cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Working knowledge of Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks
  • Experience with API integration, microservices, and scalable system design
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with global stakeholders

Highlights

  • Long term (12+ monthts)
  • 40 hrs/week

Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos:Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações\ "Z\" tradicionais em favor deextensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.Requisitos e qualificaçõesEcossistema SAP:Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno:Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud:Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica:Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description: About Regrow Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.About the Role As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow's commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil's agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow's platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.What You'll Do Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow's presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil's grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.What You'll Bring Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.Nice to Have Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish.Why Regrow Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits.Acerca de Regrow Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.Sobre el Rol Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.Qué Harás Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas. Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Qué Aportarás Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos. Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo. Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial. Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras. Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS. Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas. Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento. Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués. Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular. Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Deseable Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento. Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales. Conocimiento funcional del español.Por Qué Regrow Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real. Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica. Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas. Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure:Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means:Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop:Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty:We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation:Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation:Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team:Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades .Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Engenheiro Sênior Base24
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro Sênior Base24 com forte experiência em sistemas de processamento de pagamentos, especialmente em ambientes ACI Base24. Este profissional atuará como responsável técnico pelas plataformas Base24, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho e melhoria contínua de sistemas críticos de transações financeiras. A função exige profundo conhecimento da arquitetura Base24 (EPS e Classic), ambientes NonStop e fluxos de autorização de pagamentos (ATM e POS), aliado à capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders de negócio e fornecedores externos em ecossistemas complexos e multiplataforma.Qualificações Principais:
- Sólido entendimento da arquitetura Base24 EPS e da estrutura de módulos
- Experiência com scripting no Base24 EPS
- Forte conhecimento da arquitetura Base24 Classic
- Expertise em princípios de autorização ATM e POS
- Conhecimento operacional do produto WebGate
- Forte entendimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP)
- Experiência prática com ferramentas NonStop: Batchcom, SCF, FUP, TACL, comandos e navegação EMS
- Conhecimento do utilitário ACI NCPCOM (finalidade, comandos e princípios operacionais)
- Experiência com configuração de rede Base24 XPNET
- Experiência em programação com C++, C e TAL
- Forte habilidade com macros TACL e desenvolvimento de scripts
- Conhecimento da linguagem SQL e seus comandos
- Entendimento dos padrões EMV, verificação de cartões e conceitos de segurança de PIN.Principais Responsabilidades:
- Navegar e gerenciar estruturas de configuração do Base24 utilizando ferramentas de interface (UI)

Cloud Knowledge: Solid experience with Azure (Functions, App Service, and Blob Storage);
API Development: Experience with REST APIs and integrating third-party AI services;

Solid experience with Git.Highly Desirable Skills Experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search;
Knowledge of Vector Databases and RAG architectures;
Experience with automated testing (Unit, Integration) for AI-driven applications;
Familiarity with AI Observability tools (Tracing, Prompt Logging);
Experience with Tailwind CSS or fast prototyping UI libraries;
Knowledge of Docker andCI/CD pipelines within Azure DevOps.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies.
