title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Senior Fullstack Developer — bTd Travel & JetsBTD Business Traveler Deals Brazil Ltda · 100% Remote Contractor · Full-TimeApril 2026Who We Are bTd Travel & Jets is a high-luxury corporate concierge platform that redefines how enterprises manage premium travel. We unify private jet bookings, helicopter transfers, and first-class commercial flights into a single, seamless experience — and we're building the AI layer that makes it all feel effortless. Our mission is simple: let travelers focus on their business (or their vacation) while we handle every detail with precision and elegance. We serve enterprise clients who expect nothing less than perfection, and our technology needs to match that standard.The Role We're looking for aSenior Fullstack Developerwho thrives at the intersection of robust platform engineering and cutting-edge AI. You'll own end-to-end features — from a polished React UI to a Supabase edge function to a live AI agent pipeline — and you'll play a central role in buildingbTd Bella, our AI concierge agent powered by AWS Bedrock. This is ahands-on engineering role. You will build, ship, and iterate in production — not just advise. If you've deployed AI agents that real users depend on and you love owning hard problems from architecture to release, we want to hear from you.What You'll DoMigrate production infrastructure— move our environment from Replit to a dedicated, secure, and scalable VPS, building the foundation for the next phase of growth. Architect and ship bTd Bella— own the full lifecycle of our AWS Bedrock managed agent: setup, tool integration, knowledge base, guardrails, prompt tuning, and observability. Build AI-powered platform features— intelligent travel search, natural language booking flows, automated approval workflows, and proactive traveler notifications. Expand travel and payment integrations— POS providers, GDS/NDC APIs, Stripe, and Expedia Pay. Raise the bar on code quality and architecture— consolidate the codebase, enforce security standards, and mentor the team on AI and fullstack best practices.✦ bTd Bella — AI Concierge Agent · AWS Bedrock Bella is the heart of our AI strategy. She is a fully managed, multi-step conversational agent that assists corporate travelers with everything — finding flights, booking private jets, managing itineraries, routing approvals, and sending proactive alerts — all within a secure, policy-aware enterprise environment. Your mission with Bella:configure, deploy, and continuously improve a production-grade managed agent on AWS Bedrock. You'll define her tools, shape her reasoning, connect her to live data sources, and keep her accurate, safe, and cost-efficient at scale.What you'll build for BellaManaged Agent Setup— Configure and deploy Bella as a fully managed agent on AWS Bedrock Agents: define action groups, instruction sets, session memory, and tool-calling behavior from end to end. Tool & API Integration— Connect Bella to flight search APIs, booking systems, approval workflows, and billing via Lambda-backed action groups with clean OpenAPI schemas. Knowledge & RAG Pipeline— Build and maintain the retrieval pipeline powering Bella's knowledge: travel policies, vendor catalogs, and traveler preferences via Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Guardrails & Safety— Implement Bedrock Guardrails to keep Bella on-topic, PII-safe, and hallucination-resistant in every interaction. Prompt Engineering— Write and iterate on Bella's system prompts, persona, and reasoning instructions so her responses feel accurate, human, and on-brand for luxury travel. Evaluation & Reliability— Build evaluation pipelines to track tool-selection accuracy, response quality, and latency — and act on the results continuously.Tech StackFrontend:React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui Backend:Deno/TypeScript Edge Functions via Supabase Database:PostgreSQL with RLS, pgvector Infrastructure:Linux VPS, NGINX, Docker, SSL/Let's Encrypt CI/CD:GitHub Actions Payments:Stripe, Expedia Pay AI & Agents:AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Amazon Nova, Titan Embeddings), Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, LangChainWhat We're Looking ForFullstack Engineering5+ years building production applications with TypeScript across the full stack (React + Node.Js/Deno). Deep React 18 expertise: TanStack Query, react-hook-form, TailwindCSS, and scalable component architecture. Solid Supabase experience — Auth, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and safe migrations. Advanced PostgreSQL: complex queries, indexing strategies, transactions, and window functions. DevOps fluency: Linux VPS administration, NGINX, Docker, systemd, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions. Payment integration experience, preferably Stripe — idempotency, webhook verification, and signature handling. Third-party API integrations including POS systems, GDS/NDC travel platforms, and async webhook handling with retry logic. Security-first mindset: least privilege, secret management, and OWASP Top 10 compliance. AI, Agents — Hands-On RequiredWe need real, production experience — not theory. If you've set up a managed agent on AWS Bedrock, connected it to live tools, and made it work reliably under load, that's exactly what we're hiring for.Hands-on experience setting up fully managed agents on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar— action group definition, instruction tuning, session memory configuration, and multi-step tool-calling orchestration. Experience building Lambda-backed action groups with OpenAPI schema authoring, error handling, and idempotency. Practical knowledge of Bedrock Knowledge Bases: S3 data ingestion, chunking strategies, Titan Embeddings, and semantic retrieval tuning. Strong prompt engineering skills: system prompt design, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output enforcement, and persona calibration. Experience with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filtering, PII redaction, topic denial policies, and grounding checks. Ability to design and implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows — approval steps, escalation paths, and agent override mechanisms. AWS IAM design for Bedrock workloads: service roles, Lambda execution roles, and least-privilege cross-service access patterns. LLM cost management: token budget strategies, model tier selection, caching, and per-tenant consumption monitoring. AI observability experience: tracing agent steps, logging LLM inputs/outputs, and evaluating response quality with CloudWatch, LangSmith, or equivalent. DifferentiatorsExperience in the travel industry — GDS, NDC, Amadeus, Sabre, or Expedia. AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML Specialty). Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/worker agents, parallel tool execution, and EventBridge-triggered workflows. AWS Step Functions for orchestrating long-running agentic workflows with human approval gates. Background in multi-tenant SaaS architecture. Comfortable with AI productivity tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. Technical English for communication with international partners. What We Offer100% remotewith flexible hours — work where and when you do your best work. Real autonomy— your architectural decisions ship and your engineering impact is visible every day. A technically ambitious project at the intersection of luxury travel and cutting-edge AI. Modern, well-defined stack with no legacy baggage — we move fast and build things right. Full-time contract withcompetitive compensationmatched to your seniority level.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Especialista De Conteúdo
description: ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimentoSOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.Conheça mais em:  agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Customer Service Representative
description: Company Overview: At RDS Same Day Delivery, we specialize in providing seamless last-mile delivery solutions that connect our clients with their customers quickly and efficiently. We pride ourselves on reliability, transparency, and customer care in every delivery.Position Summary: We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Inbound Customer Service Representative to join our team. In this role, you will be pivotal in upholding our commitment to exceptional customer satisfaction by managing incoming communications, assisting with order tracking, and providing vital information to clients and prospects.Key Responsibilities: Manage inbound calls and emails from clients, addressing inquiries, providing updates, and accurately entering order details into the system. Monitor and update order statuses, ensuring clients receive real-time information on their deliveries. Support clients and prospects by delivering comprehensive information on services, delivery options, pricing, and account management. Respond promptly to customer inquiries, resolve issues, and escalate complex concerns to the appropriate team members as needed. Work closely with the operations and dispatch teams to facilitate effective communication regarding delivery updates, potential delays, and customer feedback, ensuring streamlined solutions for clients.Qualifications: Demonstrated experience in a customer service role, ideally within the logistics, delivery, or transportation industry. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to think on your feet, solve customer issues quickly, and adapt to unexpected situations. Strong Communication: Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills, ensuring clients feel valued and heard. Language Proficiency: Strong command of the English language, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in both verbal and written formats. Team Collaboration: Comfortable working closely with other teams (such as dispatch and operations) to ensure clients are satisfied with resolutions and to provide additional support as needed after the initial call. Excellent multitasking and time-management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Proficient in CRM software and comfortable with basic data entry and tracking systems.Additional Information: This is a remote full-time position with a consistent schedule that includes availability to work on Saturdays, with one weekday off in place of the Saturday shift.From time to time, additional support may also be needed during peak periods, such as evenings or holidays, flexibility in these situations is appreciated.We'd love to learn more about you. As a next step, we invite you to complete a brief Culture Index survey. In addition to reviewing your qualifications and experience, this survey helps us better understand overall fit. title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description: About us Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you'll be working directly on accounts most agencies don't get near. We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We've built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy. We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we're positioning ourselves at the front of it.The role We're looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets. You'll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short. You'll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.What we're looking for We're only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you're earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn't the right fit yet. You should have: 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz's awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative Proven spend behind your work — creatives you've written that have run profitably at scale Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.What we offer Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that. You'll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously. This is a fully remote position.One thing worth knowing There's a short test task as part of the application process. It's there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.Apply Here:

title: Business Development Representative

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho: - Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades em toda a stack (React + .NET + SQL Server);

- Conhecimento em GitHub Copilot ou outras ferramentas de apoio à produtividade de código.Onde você vai trabalhar? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.We're a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.The RoleWe're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and be able to diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom, identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!What You'll DoMonitor Intercom and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, and request handling Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help Engineering prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution stepsWhat We're Looking ForRequired Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problemsNice to Have Prior experience with financial data APIs or market data platforms Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Understanding of options markets and derivatives data Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validationWhy Theta DataRapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter;

title: Especialista De Conteúdo
description: ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimentoSOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.Conheça mais em:  agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. title: Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you'll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you'll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About Theta DataTheta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.We're a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.The RoleWe're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and be able to diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom, identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!What You'll DoMonitor Intercom and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, and request handling Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help Engineering prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution stepsWhat We're Looking ForRequired Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problemsNice to Have Prior experience with financial data APIs or market data platforms Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Understanding of options markets and derivatives data Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validationWhy Theta DataRapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter;
an influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Analista De Implantação Erp - Módulo Fiscal/Contábil
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.

Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.

Responsabilidades:

  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testesdas funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.

Requisitos:

  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens;

Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:

  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.
  • Conhecimento Fiscal: ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, FCP, IPI, FUNRURAL, Sped Fiscal, Sped Contribuições, EFD REINF, NCM, CEST, CST, CFOP, retenções na fonte sobre serviços tomados/prestados (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS).

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ouvivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Experiência comImplantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
  • Ensino Superiorem Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;
  • Experiência comVarejo;
  • Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;
  • Experiência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Visão analíticapara apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Senior Fullstack Developer — bTd Travel & JetsBTD Business Traveler Deals Brazil Ltda · 100% Remote Contractor · Full-TimeApril 2026Who We Are bTd Travel & Jets is a high-luxury corporate concierge platform that redefines how enterprises manage premium travel. We unify private jet bookings, helicopter transfers, and first-class commercial flights into a single, seamless experience — and we're building the AI layer that makes it all feel effortless. Our mission is simple: let travelers focus on their business (or their vacation) while we handle every detail with precision and elegance. We serve enterprise clients who expect nothing less than perfection, and our technology needs to match that standard.The Role We're looking for aSenior Fullstack Developerwho thrives at the intersection of robust platform engineering and cutting-edge AI. You'll own end-to-end features — from a polished React UI to a Supabase edge function to a live AI agent pipeline — and you'll play a central role in buildingbTd Bella, our AI concierge agent powered by AWS Bedrock. This is ahands-on engineering role. You will build, ship, and iterate in production — not just advise. If you've deployed AI agents that real users depend on and you love owning hard problems from architecture to release, we want to hear from you.What You'll DoMigrate production infrastructure— move our environment from Replit to a dedicated, secure, and scalable VPS, building the foundation for the next phase of growth. Architect and ship bTd Bella— own the full lifecycle of our AWS Bedrock managed agent: setup, tool integration, knowledge base, guardrails, prompt tuning, and observability. Build AI-powered platform features— intelligent travel search, natural language booking flows, automated approval workflows, and proactive traveler notifications. Expand travel and payment integrations— POS providers, GDS/NDC APIs, Stripe, and Expedia Pay. Raise the bar on code quality and architecture— consolidate the codebase, enforce security standards, and mentor the team on AI and fullstack best practices.✦ bTd Bella — AI Concierge Agent · AWS Bedrock Bella is the heart of our AI strategy. She is a fully managed, multi-step conversational agent that assists corporate travelers with everything — finding flights, booking private jets, managing itineraries, routing approvals, and sending proactive alerts — all within a secure, policy-aware enterprise environment. Your mission with Bella:configure, deploy, and continuously improve a production-grade managed agent on AWS Bedrock. You'll define her tools, shape her reasoning, connect her to live data sources, and keep her accurate, safe, and cost-efficient at scale.What you'll build for BellaManaged Agent Setup— Configure and deploy Bella as a fully managed agent on AWS Bedrock Agents: define action groups, instruction sets, session memory, and tool-calling behavior from end to end. Tool & API Integration— Connect Bella to flight search APIs, booking systems, approval workflows, and billing via Lambda-backed action groups with clean OpenAPI schemas. Knowledge & RAG Pipeline— Build and maintain the retrieval pipeline powering Bella's knowledge: travel policies, vendor catalogs, and traveler preferences via Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Guardrails & Safety— Implement Bedrock Guardrails to keep Bella on-topic, PII-safe, and hallucination-resistant in every interaction. Prompt Engineering— Write and iterate on Bella's system prompts, persona, and reasoning instructions so her responses feel accurate, human, and on-brand for luxury travel. Evaluation & Reliability— Build evaluation pipelines to track tool-selection accuracy, response quality, and latency — and act on the results continuously.Tech StackFrontend:React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui Backend:Deno/TypeScript Edge Functions via Supabase Database:PostgreSQL with RLS, pgvector Infrastructure:Linux VPS, NGINX, Docker, SSL/Let's Encrypt CI/CD:GitHub Actions Payments:Stripe, Expedia Pay AI & Agents:AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Amazon Nova, Titan Embeddings), Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, LangChainWhat We're Looking ForFullstack Engineering5+ years building production applications with TypeScript across the full stack (React + Node.Js/Deno). Deep React 18 expertise: TanStack Query, react-hook-form, TailwindCSS, and scalable component architecture. Solid Supabase experience — Auth, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and safe migrations. Advanced PostgreSQL: complex queries, indexing strategies, transactions, and window functions. DevOps fluency: Linux VPS administration, NGINX, Docker, systemd, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions. Payment integration experience, preferably Stripe — idempotency, webhook verification, and signature handling. Third-party API integrations including POS systems, GDS/NDC travel platforms, and async webhook handling with retry logic. Security-first mindset: least privilege, secret management, and OWASP Top 10 compliance. AI, Agents — Hands-On RequiredWe need real, production experience — not theory. If you've set up a managed agent on AWS Bedrock, connected it to live tools, and made it work reliably under load, that's exactly what we're hiring for.Hands-on experience setting up fully managed agents on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar— action group definition, instruction tuning, session memory configuration, and multi-step tool-calling orchestration. Experience building Lambda-backed action groups with OpenAPI schema authoring, error handling, and idempotency. Practical knowledge of Bedrock Knowledge Bases: S3 data ingestion, chunking strategies, Titan Embeddings, and semantic retrieval tuning. Strong prompt engineering skills: system prompt design, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output enforcement, and persona calibration. Experience with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filtering, PII redaction, topic denial policies, and grounding checks. Ability to design and implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows — approval steps, escalation paths, and agent override mechanisms. AWS IAM design for Bedrock workloads: service roles, Lambda execution roles, and least-privilege cross-service access patterns. LLM cost management: token budget strategies, model tier selection, caching, and per-tenant consumption monitoring. AI observability experience: tracing agent steps, logging LLM inputs/outputs, and evaluating response quality with CloudWatch, LangSmith, or equivalent. DifferentiatorsExperience in the travel industry — GDS, NDC, Amadeus, Sabre, or Expedia. AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML Specialty). Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/worker agents, parallel tool execution, and EventBridge-triggered workflows. AWS Step Functions for orchestrating long-running agentic workflows with human approval gates. Background in multi-tenant SaaS architecture. Comfortable with AI productivity tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. Technical English for communication with international partners. What We Offer100% remotewith flexible hours — work where and when you do your best work. Real autonomy— your architectural decisions ship and your engineering impact is visible every day. A technically ambitious project at the intersection of luxury travel and cutting-edge AI. Modern, well-defined stack with no legacy baggage — we move fast and build things right. Full-time contract withcompetitive compensationmatched to your seniority level.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About Theta DataTheta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.We're a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.The RoleWe're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and be able to diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom, identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too!What You'll DoMonitor Intercom and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, and request handling Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help Engineering prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution stepsWhat We're Looking ForRequired Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problemsNice to Have Prior experience with financial data APIs or market data platforms Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Understanding of options markets and derivatives data Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validationWhy Theta DataRapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter;
an influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Coordenador(A) De Operações | Benefícios Seguráveis E Não Seguráveis
description: Coordenador(a) de Operações | Benefícios Seguráveis e Não SeguráveisSobre a Iresa Somos uma corretora boutique em ritmo acelerado de crescimento. Nosso DNA une o conhecimento técnico das corretoras tradicionais com a agilidade e modernidade da tecnologia. Somos orientados ao cliente (client first) e utilizamos IA e ferramentas modernas para sustentar nossa estrutura. Vamos além do\ "arroz com feijão\" bem feito: operamos como um braço estratégico do RH, desenvolvendo processos, iniciativas e melhorias que causam impacto real. Atuamos com excelência na execução dos processos operacionais, com foco em benefícios seguráveis (Saúde, Odonto e Vida), mas gerindo também benefícios não seguráveis (VR, VT, Gympass e Previdência), inclusive com acesso à folha de pagamentos de clientes estratégicos.Nossa Cultura Remota Trabalhamos em modelo majoritariamente remoto, com encontros presenciais de todo o time a cada 2 meses. Para nós, o local de trabalho importa menos do que a entrega. Por isso, fundamentamos nosso modelo de cultura remota em dois pilares inegociáveis: Autorresponsabilidade: Confiamos no seu trabalho, colocando você à frente das entregas e responsabilidades da coordenação da área. Autonomia: Aqui você tem voz para questionar processos, sugerir e implementar melhorias. Queremos com a gente, quem trabalha na construção das engrenagens, indo além de apenas fazê-las girar.O que você fará: Coordenar a operação de benefícios seguráveis e não seguráveis. Supervisionar nossa interface com a folha de pagamento de clientes. Apoiar na conciliação contábil e financeira da área de benefícios. Estruturar e otimizar processos internos utilizando IA e plataformas de tecnologia. Coordenar e desenvolver o time para crescimento. Atuar de forma consultiva com clientes, operadoras e parceiros. Garantir a qualidade e o cumprimento rigoroso de prazos. Construir e acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e volumetria. Estruturar e padronizar fluxos de trabalho para sustentar o crescimento da área.O que buscamos: Experiência sólida em corretoras, consultorias e/ou RH-DP (Imprescindível). Domínio técnico de benefícios seguráveis e não seguráveis. Vivência prática com gestão de Saúde, Odonto e Vida, além de VR, VA e VT. Experiência prévia com gestão ou liderança de equipe. Capacidade de estruturar, revisar e padronizar processos. Perfil analítico com foco em eficiência e melhoria contínua. Familiaridade (ou muita vontade de aprender) sobre a aplicação de IA no dia a dia operacional. Excel avançado.O que oferecemos: Salário: vínculo CLT. Vale-Alimentação/Refeição. Plano de Saúde: Amil, com possibilidade de inclusão de dependente. Trabalho Remoto: Flexibilidade real para o seu dia a dia. Day-off no dia do aniversário. Crescimento: Exposição direta a projetos estratégicos e autonomia para brilhar.

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description: Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.Nosso Cliente Você atuará em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, com forte presença global e foco emtransformação digital, modernização de sistemas e construção de soluções escaláveis em cloud .Sobre os projetos Os projetos envolvem a modernização de sistemas corporativos críticos, com forte integração entre aplicações, dados e ambientes em nuvem. De acordo com o squad, você poderá atuar em soluções voltadas a operações, supply chain, plataformas internas ou produtos orientados a dados.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho Desenvolvimento de aplicações full stack utilizando.NET (C#) e frameworks modernos (React, Angular ou Vue) Evolução e modernização de aplicações existentes, incluindo migração de tecnologias legadas para arquiteturas modernas em cloud Desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizadas globalmente Construção e consumo de APIs RESTful Integração de dados com sistemas corporativos (como SAP) e atuação com pipelines de dados / ETL Desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e estruturas em bancos SQL Atuação com serviços em nuvem Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, APIs, bancos gerenciados, etc.) Desenvolvimento com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança Participação em projetos com arquitetura baseada em microserviços e, em alguns casos, serverless Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD Participação em cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) Troubleshooting, debugging e otimização de performance Colaboração com times globais (EUA e LATAM)O que você precisa ter Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack Forte conhecimento emC# / .NET (Core ou versões mais recentes) Experiência comReact, Angular ou Vue.Js Experiência comAPIs REST Conhecimento emSQL Server / Azure SQL Experiência comGit / GitHub Vivência comcloud (preferencialmente Azure) Inglês avançadoSerá um destaque seu perfil com: Node.Js / TypeScript no backend Azure Functions, App Services, API Management CI/CD (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) Experiência com ETL, SAP ou integração de dados Docker e microsserviços Terraform / Infrastructure as Code Experiência em times ágeis distribuídos Noções de data engineering ou analyticsOnde você vai trabalhar? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Devops Engineer
description:

Suas principais atribuições incluem: - Disponibilidade e Performance: Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e escalabilidade dos sistemas e serviços em ambientes de nuvem, aplicando práticas de Site Reliability Engineering. - Observabilidade e Confiabilidade: Projetar e manter SLIs, SLOs e SLAs, criando mecanismos de monitoramento, logging e alertas proativos, prevenindo incidentes antes que afetem os usuários finais. - Automação e Entrega Contínua: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar deploys, testes e integrações contínuas, reduzindo riscos e aumentando a eficiência. - Gestão de Incidentes: Implementar processos de incident response e post-mortem para identificar, mitigar e aprender com falhas, garantindo melhoria contínua. - Segurança e Compliance: Implementar e manter práticas de segurança de alto nível para proteger dados e cumprir normas de privacidade e compliance (ex.: PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR). - Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar ferramentas de automação e IaC (Infrastructure as Code) para provisionamento, configuração e manutenção de ambientes em AWS ou outras nuvens públicas. - Suporte e Orientação Técnica: Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento, fornecendo orientação sobre práticas de DevOps, infraestrutura e arquitetura, além de atuar como ponto técnico focal. - Otimização de Custos: Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e otimização de recursos na infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.Requisitos: - Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações (AIOps), incluindo uso de modelos para detecção de anomalias, previsão de incidentes e automação inteligente de respostas. Experiência com integração de serviços de IA (ex.: APIs de modelos de linguagem), uso de pipelines de dados para treinamento/consumo de modelos e entendimento de conceitos como Machine Learning, NLP e observabilidade orientada por IA. - Experiência sólida em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e troubleshooting. - Proficiência em automação e IaC, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares. - Experiência prática em cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancer). - Vivência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes). - Conhecimento em serviços web e servidores (Nginx, Apache, IIS, etc.). - Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade, usando ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Graylog, Datadog ou similares. - Forte compreensão de práticas DevOps e SRE (SLI/SLO, capacidade de resposta a incidentes, gestão de disponibilidade). - Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares). - Habilidades de comunicação para colaborar com times multidisciplinares e interagir com clientes. - Certificações em AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes ou áreas correlatas são altamente desejáveis.Desejáveis: - Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta disponibilidade (produtos de larga escala). - Atuação anterior em equipes de SRE ou como engenheiro responsável por confiabilidade de sistemas críticos. - Conhecimentos de FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.Vantagens: - Programa de mentoria que te acompanha durante sua fase de adaptação;
- Vaga 100% remota;
- Acesso a cursos e certificações;
- Aulas de inglês custeada pela empresa.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner
