title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)About Us XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today's competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.About the Role As aBusiness Development Representative (BDR), you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives). This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You'll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team. You'll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.About You We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales. English Proficiency– Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives. Sales Mindset– Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline. Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred)– Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus. Curious & Coachable– Eager to learn and grow;
open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training. Self-Starter– Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members. Tech-Savvy– Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms. Comfortable in afast-paced, evolving environment .Key Responsibilities Lead Generation Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts. Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos. Team Coordination Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs. Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team's success. Data Management Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs. Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date. Metrics & KPIs Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate. Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked. Email outreach volume and reply rate. Meeting attendance rate. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours/week. Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET. Open to applicants based in LATAM. What We Offer Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split). SPIFFs and performance incentives. Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you'll jump to the front of the line.

title: Arquiteto Shopify
description: Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções com forte experiência no ecossistema Shopify para atuar na definição e implementação de soluções robustas, escaláveis e orientadas a negócio. Essa pessoa será responsável por conectar requisitos de negócio com capacidades técnicas da plataforma, liderando decisões arquiteturais e garantindo a entrega de soluções eficientes em ambientes complexos, especialmente em contextos enterprise.Principais responsabilidades: Atuar diretamente com clientes (merchants) em parceria com Business Analysts para levantamento e entendimento de requisitos de negócio. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis dentro do ecossistema Shopify. Desenvolver provas de conceito (POCs) para validação de abordagens e mitigação de riscos. Definir e liderar a arquitetura de soluções end-to-end, incluindo integrações com APIs, middleware e sistemas como ERP, PIM e OMS. Estabelecer padrões de arquitetura, seleção de aplicações e modelagem de dados. Documentar decisões técnicas, arquiteturas e mapeamentos de dados. Utilizar ferramentas de IA para pesquisa, prototipação, planejamento e revisão técnica. Alternar entre execução prática e delegação conforme a necessidade dos projetos.Requisitos técnicos: Experiência sólida com Shopify Plus e Shopify B2B. Vivência com integrações enterprise e arquiteturas distribuídas. Conhecimento em plataformas PIM e iPaaS. Experiência em design de soluções e definição arquitetural. Domínio em criação de diagramas de arquitetura. Experiência com ferramentas do Atlassian (Confluence e Jira). Familiaridade com Figma Dev Mode.Requisitos desejáveis: Experiência prévia em agências digitais ou projetos de entrega de software em ambientes corporativos. Habilidade em gestão de stakeholders e liderança técnica. Experiência prática com tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos e multidisciplinares.Informações adicionais: Atuação 100% remota Contrato PJ + benefícios

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Sobre nós: A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis. Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras. Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS. É a primeira de seu setor na Global Data Alliance junto a companhias como Panasonic, Visa, Pfizer e American Express.Descrição: - Será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência de nossas plataformas e produtos digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta em arquitetura, automação e operações. Suas principais atribuições incluem: - Disponibilidade e Performance: Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e escalabilidade dos sistemas e serviços em ambientes de nuvem, aplicando práticas de Site Reliability Engineering. - Observabilidade e Confiabilidade: Projetar e manter SLIs, SLOs e SLAs, criando mecanismos de monitoramento, logging e alertas proativos, prevenindo incidentes antes que afetem os usuários finais. - Automação e Entrega Contínua: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar deploys, testes e integrações contínuas, reduzindo riscos e aumentando a eficiência. - Gestão de Incidentes: Implementar processos de incident response e post-mortem para identificar, mitigar e aprender com falhas, garantindo melhoria contínua. - Segurança e Compliance: Implementar e manter práticas de segurança de alto nível para proteger dados e cumprir normas de privacidade e compliance (ex.: PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR). - Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar ferramentas de automação e IaC (Infrastructure as Code) para provisionamento, configuração e manutenção de ambientes em AWS ou outras nuvens públicas. - Suporte e Orientação Técnica: Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento, fornecendo orientação sobre práticas de DevOps, infraestrutura e arquitetura, além de atuar como ponto técnico focal. - Otimização de Custos: Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e otimização de recursos na infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.Requisitos: - Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações (AIOps), incluindo uso de modelos para detecção de anomalias, previsão de incidentes e automação inteligente de respostas. Experiência com integração de serviços de IA (ex.: APIs de modelos de linguagem), uso de pipelines de dados para treinamento/consumo de modelos e entendimento de conceitos como Machine Learning, NLP e observabilidade orientada por IA. - Experiência sólida em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e troubleshooting. - Proficiência em automação e IaC, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares. - Experiência prática em cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancer). - Vivência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes). - Conhecimento em serviços web e servidores (Nginx, Apache, IIS, etc.). - Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade, usando ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Graylog, Datadog ou similares. - Forte compreensão de práticas DevOps e SRE (SLI/SLO, capacidade de resposta a incidentes, gestão de disponibilidade). - Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares). - Habilidades de comunicação para colaborar com times multidisciplinares e interagir com clientes. - Certificações em AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes ou áreas correlatas são altamente desejáveis.Desejáveis: - Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta disponibilidade (produtos de larga escala). - Atuação anterior em equipes de SRE ou como engenheiro responsável por confiabilidade de sistemas críticos. - Conhecimentos de FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.Vantagens: - Programa de mentoria que te acompanha durante sua fase de adaptação;
- Vaga 100% remota;
- Acesso a cursos e certificações;
- Aulas de inglês custeada pela empresa.

title: Consultor De Pré Vendas
description:
Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo! A EasyJur é uma Legaltech com missão de revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio de inteligência humana e artificial. Todo advogado que adota o #easyjur como solução central percebe rapidamente os benefícios da transformação digital. Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para construir não apenas um software jurídico — mas um mundo mais justo. Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!O que a gente espera de você? Buscamos um SDR Sênior que queira ser protagonista em um time comercial de alta performance estruturado em Sales PODs. A pessoa ideal tem visão de processo, opera com autonomia, e entende que prospecção de qualidade não é volume e sim diagnóstico. Você será responsável por construir e qualificar pipeline com precisão, garantindo que cada lead que avança para o Closer chegue com contexto real, dor mapeada e próximo passo claro.No seu dia a dia, você vai: Executar cadências de qualificação de inbound, segmentadas por perfil de ICP e nível de consciência do lead, utilizando o HubSpot. Conduzir as primeiras conversas com foco em diagnóstico inicial: mapear Situação e Dor do potencial cliente utilizando o framework SPICED como guia de qualificação. Operar e alimentar agentes de comunicação (IA) integrados ao fluxo de prospecção, garantindo que a automação potencialize a abordagem consultiva. Registrar e manter a higiene dos dados no HubSpot em tempo real, documentando interações, estágio do lead e sinalizadores de qualificação com rigor. Realizar o handoff qualificado para o Closer com o SPICED parcialmente preenchido e o contexto necessário para uma reunião de Discovery de alto nível. Atuar em colaboração direta dentro do Sales POD, participando de dailies com o Closer e o CSM para destravar oportunidades e alinhar estratégias de abordagem. Contribuir com a construção e melhoria contínua dos scripts, cadências e critérios de descarte, com base em dados e feedback do funil.O que buscamos de conhecimento técnico? Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em SDR ou Inside Sales B2B. Familiaridade com o framework SPICED (ou metodologias de vendas baseadas em impacto como MEDDIC, MEDDPICC) e mentalidade diagnóstica antes de prescrever. Domínio operacional do HubSpot: gestão de sequências, propriedades de contato, leadscore e relatórios de funil. Experiência ou abertura real para operar com agentes de IA/automação de comunicação integrados ao processo de prospecção. Capacidade de argumentação consultiva: entender o negócio do lead o suficiente para qualificar com precisão, não apenas agendar reunião. title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Senior Fullstack Developer — bTd Travel & JetsBTD Business Traveler Deals Brazil Ltda · 100% Remote Contractor · Full-TimeApril 2026Who We Are bTd Travel & Jets is a high-luxury corporate concierge platform that redefines how enterprises manage premium travel. We unify private jet bookings, helicopter transfers, and first-class commercial flights into a single, seamless experience — and we're building the AI layer that makes it all feel effortless. Our mission is simple: let travelers focus on their business (or their vacation) while we handle every detail with precision and elegance. We serve enterprise clients who expect nothing less than perfection, and our technology needs to match that standard.The Role We're looking for aSenior Fullstack Developerwho thrives at the intersection of robust platform engineering and cutting-edge AI. You'll own end-to-end features — from a polished React UI to a Supabase edge function to a live AI agent pipeline — and you'll play a central role in buildingbTd Bella, our AI concierge agent powered by AWS Bedrock. This is ahands-on engineering role. You will build, ship, and iterate in production — not just advise. If you've deployed AI agents that real users depend on and you love owning hard problems from architecture to release, we want to hear from you.What You'll DoMigrate production infrastructure— move our environment from Replit to a dedicated, secure, and scalable VPS, building the foundation for the next phase of growth. Architect and ship bTd Bella— own the full lifecycle of our AWS Bedrock managed agent: setup, tool integration, knowledge base, guardrails, prompt tuning, and observability. Build AI-powered platform features— intelligent travel search, natural language booking flows, automated approval workflows, and proactive traveler notifications. Expand travel and payment integrations— POS providers, GDS/NDC APIs, Stripe, and Expedia Pay. Raise the bar on code quality and architecture— consolidate the codebase, enforce security standards, and mentor the team on AI and fullstack best practices.✦ bTd Bella — AI Concierge Agent · AWS Bedrock Bella is the heart of our AI strategy. She is a fully managed, multi-step conversational agent that assists corporate travelers with everything — finding flights, booking private jets, managing itineraries, routing approvals, and sending proactive alerts — all within a secure, policy-aware enterprise environment. Your mission with Bella:configure, deploy, and continuously improve a production-grade managed agent on AWS Bedrock. You'll define her tools, shape her reasoning, connect her to live data sources, and keep her accurate, safe, and cost-efficient at scale.What you'll build for BellaManaged Agent Setup— Configure and deploy Bella as a fully managed agent on AWS Bedrock Agents: define action groups, instruction sets, session memory, and tool-calling behavior from end to end. Tool & API Integration— Connect Bella to flight search APIs, booking systems, approval workflows, and billing via Lambda-backed action groups with clean OpenAPI schemas. Knowledge & RAG Pipeline— Build and maintain the retrieval pipeline powering Bella's knowledge: travel policies, vendor catalogs, and traveler preferences via Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Guardrails & Safety— Implement Bedrock Guardrails to keep Bella on-topic, PII-safe, and hallucination-resistant in every interaction. Prompt Engineering— Write and iterate on Bella's system prompts, persona, and reasoning instructions so her responses feel accurate, human, and on-brand for luxury travel. Evaluation & Reliability— Build evaluation pipelines to track tool-selection accuracy, response quality, and latency — and act on the results continuously.Tech StackFrontend:React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui Backend:Deno/TypeScript Edge Functions via Supabase Database:PostgreSQL with RLS, pgvector Infrastructure:Linux VPS, NGINX, Docker, SSL/Let's Encrypt CI/CD:GitHub Actions Payments:Stripe, Expedia Pay AI & Agents:AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Amazon Nova, Titan Embeddings), Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, LangChainWhat We're Looking ForFullstack Engineering5+ years building production applications with TypeScript across the full stack (React + Node.Js/Deno). Deep React 18 expertise: TanStack Query, react-hook-form, TailwindCSS, and scalable component architecture. Solid Supabase experience — Auth, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and safe migrations. Advanced PostgreSQL: complex queries, indexing strategies, transactions, and window functions. DevOps fluency: Linux VPS administration, NGINX, Docker, systemd, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions. Payment integration experience, preferably Stripe — idempotency, webhook verification, and signature handling. Third-party API integrations including POS systems, GDS/NDC travel platforms, and async webhook handling with retry logic. Security-first mindset: least privilege, secret management, and OWASP Top 10 compliance. AI, Agents — Hands-On RequiredWe need real, production experience — not theory. If you've set up a managed agent on AWS Bedrock, connected it to live tools, and made it work reliably under load, that's exactly what we're hiring for.Hands-on experience setting up fully managed agents on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar— action group definition, instruction tuning, session memory configuration, and multi-step tool-calling orchestration. Experience building Lambda-backed action groups with OpenAPI schema authoring, error handling, and idempotency. Practical knowledge of Bedrock Knowledge Bases: S3 data ingestion, chunking strategies, Titan Embeddings, and semantic retrieval tuning. Strong prompt engineering skills: system prompt design, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output enforcement, and persona calibration. Experience with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filtering, PII redaction, topic denial policies, and grounding checks. Ability to design and implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows — approval steps, escalation paths, and agent override mechanisms. AWS IAM design for Bedrock workloads: service roles, Lambda execution roles, and least-privilege cross-service access patterns. LLM cost management: token budget strategies, model tier selection, caching, and per-tenant consumption monitoring. AI observability experience: tracing agent steps, logging LLM inputs/outputs, and evaluating response quality with CloudWatch, LangSmith, or equivalent. DifferentiatorsExperience in the travel industry — GDS, NDC, Amadeus, Sabre, or Expedia. AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML Specialty). Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/worker agents, parallel tool execution, and EventBridge-triggered workflows. AWS Step Functions for orchestrating long-running agentic workflows with human approval gates. Background in multi-tenant SaaS architecture. Comfortable with AI productivity tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. Technical English for communication with international partners. What We Offer100% remotewith flexible hours — work where and when you do your best work. Real autonomy— your architectural decisions ship and your engineering impact is visible every day. A technically ambitious project at the intersection of luxury travel and cutting-edge AI. Modern, well-defined stack with no legacy baggage — we move fast and build things right. Full-time contract withcompetitive compensationmatched to your seniority level.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Sobre nós: A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis. Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras. Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS. É a primeira de seu setor na Global Data Alliance junto a companhias como Panasonic, Visa, Pfizer e American Express.Descrição: - Será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência de nossas plataformas e produtos digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta em arquitetura, automação e operações. Suas principais atribuições incluem: - Disponibilidade e Performance: Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e escalabilidade dos sistemas e serviços em ambientes de nuvem, aplicando práticas de Site Reliability Engineering. - Observabilidade e Confiabilidade: Projetar e manter SLIs, SLOs e SLAs, criando mecanismos de monitoramento, logging e alertas proativos, prevenindo incidentes antes que afetem os usuários finais. - Automação e Entrega Contínua: Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar deploys, testes e integrações contínuas, reduzindo riscos e aumentando a eficiência. - Gestão de Incidentes: Implementar processos de incident response e post-mortem para identificar, mitigar e aprender com falhas, garantindo melhoria contínua. - Segurança e Compliance: Implementar e manter práticas de segurança de alto nível para proteger dados e cumprir normas de privacidade e compliance (ex.: PCI-DSS, LGPD/GDPR). - Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar ferramentas de automação e IaC (Infrastructure as Code) para provisionamento, configuração e manutenção de ambientes em AWS ou outras nuvens públicas. - Suporte e Orientação Técnica: Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento, fornecendo orientação sobre práticas de DevOps, infraestrutura e arquitetura, além de atuar como ponto técnico focal. - Otimização de Custos: Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e otimização de recursos na infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.Requisitos: - Conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a operações (AIOps), incluindo uso de modelos para detecção de anomalias, previsão de incidentes e automação inteligente de respostas. Experiência com integração de serviços de IA (ex.: APIs de modelos de linguagem), uso de pipelines de dados para treinamento/consumo de modelos e entendimento de conceitos como Machine Learning, NLP e observabilidade orientada por IA. - Experiência sólida em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e troubleshooting. - Proficiência em automação e IaC, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares. - Experiência prática em cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancer). - Vivência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes). - Conhecimento em serviços web e servidores (Nginx, Apache, IIS, etc.). - Experiência em monitoramento e observabilidade, usando ferramentas como Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Graylog, Datadog ou similares. - Forte compreensão de práticas DevOps e SRE (SLI/SLO, capacidade de resposta a incidentes, gestão de disponibilidade). - Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares). - Habilidades de comunicação para colaborar com times multidisciplinares e interagir com clientes. - Certificações em AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes ou áreas correlatas são altamente desejáveis.Desejáveis: - Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta disponibilidade (produtos de larga escala). - Atuação anterior em equipes de SRE ou como engenheiro responsável por confiabilidade de sistemas críticos. - Conhecimentos de FinOps para otimização de custos em cloud.Vantagens: - Programa de mentoria que te acompanha durante sua fase de adaptação;
- Vaga 100% remota;
- Acesso a cursos e certificações;
- Aulas de inglês custeada pela empresa.

Platform-native editing for vertical and horizontal formats DaVinci Resolve proficiency is strongly preferred. Shared project experience is a major plus. Not a dealbreaker, but a significant advantage Multicam editing experience is a bonus, ideally from live events, reality TV, or unscripted formats Competent sound design and colour grading. Your grades should be clean and your audio broadcast-ready Self-directed. You can take a rough brief and deliver a polished first cut without needing frame-by-frame instructions Reliable. You deliver when you say you will. If something changes, you communicate before the deadline, not after Open to AI-assisted workflows. Specifically Higgsfield for short-form content. You don't need to be an expert, but you need to be curious Politically impartial and professional. ONDA works with clients across a range of industries, causes, and viewpoints. This role requires a professional, unbiased approach to all content — the work is the work, regardless of subject matterDetails HOURS: Part-time (roughly 30 hours per week) RATE: Competitive monthly retainer, based on experience and portfolio strength LOCATION: Fully remote. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.Responsibilities:1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.3. Review and approve merchant applications.4. Conduct market research.5. Assist with other related operational tasks.Job Requirements:1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Atlassian Consultant | Customer Facing Technical Expert
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS) Descrição da vaga Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente. Responsabilidades e atribuições Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
Acompanhar eoferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
Identificar pontos demelhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
Gestão do atendimentodos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
Garantir queas demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
Trabalhar emsinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
Acompanhar eoferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
Gestão de faturamentoe custos;
Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas. Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças. Requisitos e qualificações Formação: Graduado/Especializações. Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
Conhecimentoem análise de custos e orçamentos;
Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
Experiência com o ArcGIS;
Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
Análise e interpretação de dados. Habilidades Desejáveis: Mestrado;
Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
Conhecimentoe compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Oracle Hcm Developer (Relocation To Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines: Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference. What will you do? Analyze and resolve technical issues within Oracle HCM;
Contribute to system enhancements and ongoing development activities;
Support datahandling and data-related activities;
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure system stability and performance;
Work in an Agile environment. What are we looking for? 1 to 4 years of experience with Oracle HCM development;
Good understanding ofHR data and processes;
Ability to analyze and solve issues independently;
Experience in Agile environments;
SQL knowledge is a plus;
Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills;
Fluent in English (B2);
Available torelocate to Portugal. What do we have to offer you? Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
Feedback&Coffee– our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
Events and teambuilding activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
Health and well-beingprogramme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
We grow withyou and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;

title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description: Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) Location: LATAM Duration: 6-12months Job Summary: We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes. Key Responsibilities: ·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements. ·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows. ·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements. ·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards. ·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem. ·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met. ·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation. ·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues. ·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams. ·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization. Required Qualifications: ·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure. ·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud. ·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management. ·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. ·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications. ·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration. ·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Content Moderator
description: We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network, and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines. If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team. Job Title: Content Reviewer Location: Remote /Brazil Type: Freelance Required Engagement: 30 hours per week Key Responsibilities: - Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy - Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations - Follow project guidelines while reviewing content - Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content - Categorize and tag content appropriately Key Requirements: - Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events - Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization - Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory - Strong attention to detail and communication skills Assessment Process: Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments: - LLM Evaluation Assessment - Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between. Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality. Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces. Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution. Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels. Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines. Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them. A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva. Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.). A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience. Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro. Bonus Points Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS). Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing. Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Analista De Infraestrutura Azure Sr - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas. ♿ Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece. Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura Sobre a oportunidade: Atividades: - Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.
- Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.
- Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).
- Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.
- Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).
- Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights) Diferencial desejado: - Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).
- Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).
- Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).
- Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking). Qualidade pessoais desejadas: - Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.
- Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.
- Habilidade de resolução de problemas: - Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.
- Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.
- Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.
- Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.
- Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.
- Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.
- Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.
- Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos. Experiência anterior desejada: - Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.
- Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.
- Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).
- Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.
- Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA). Habilidades Técnicas: - Azure - AKS - AZ-104 - AZ-900 - estratégias de migração - IaC - Terraform - Bicep - On-premises - SaaS - Containers - PaaS Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto Benefícios | Clube da Four Assistência médica VR e VA flexível ️ Gympass e Wellz ⚽ Parceria com o SESC Descontos em restaurantes Descontos em cursos técnicos e ensino superior Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas E aí, aceita o desafio? Finalize sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys

Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;
Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;

Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;
Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;
Gerenciar e participarde exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);
Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);
Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);
Configurar e gerenciara comunidade online da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
Configurar e gerenciaras redes sociais da GoodWe Solar Academy no Brasil;
Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;
Treinar e certificar aequipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;
Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);
Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;
Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;
Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;
Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;
Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas Proficiência em mandarim Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em AutoCAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office eoutros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS PowerPoint;
Ampla rede de contatosno setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidadesorganizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.- Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos.Experiência anterior desejada: - Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

title: Senior Project Manager
description: Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems. This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments. The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset, with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Required Experience & Qualifications Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments. Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems. Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs. Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication. Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management. Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity. Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems. Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.G., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts. Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership. Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously. Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions. Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions. Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners. Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management. Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers. Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives. Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements. Desired Profile Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership. Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision. Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize. Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities. Strong decision-making capability and accountability. Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments. Contract & Work Model PJ (contractor) model Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you. Responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts. Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals. Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation. Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders. Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account. Requirements: A bachelor's degree 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry. Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives. Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle. Highly effective verbal and written communication skills. A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success. Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required. Why Join JoVE? A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity. Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description: AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops. Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data. System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes. Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience. QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify\ "Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment. Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions. AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. Must-haves 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end) Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data Plusses Experience with C++ development Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes Day-to-Day You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Pega Developer
description: We are hiring an experienced Pega Developer to drive digital transformation initiatives across public sector programs. This role sits at the core of mission-critical modernization efforts, combining deep technical expertise in Pega with system integration, workflow design, and scalable architecture. You will design and deliver secure, high-performance case management solutions that improve operational efficiency and service delivery for government agencies. You will transform complex business requirements into robust Pega applications — integrating enterprise systems, modernizing legacy environments, and ensuring compliance with public sector standards. This person acts as a key technical partner to Architects, Business Analysts, QA, and Delivery teams. title: Project Manager - Digital Technology
description: Project Manager - Digital Technology Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Digital Technology (DT) Project Manager to join our team. The DT Project Manager will be responsible for planning, leading, organizing, and motivating project teams to achieve a high level of performance and quality in delivering projects that provide exceptional business value to users. This role requires a high degree of collaboration with leaders across the organization. Key Responsibilities:Project Planning and Management: Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment. Scope, Schedule, and Resource Management: Manage all aspects of projects including scope, schedule, resources, quality, costs, change, and risk to ensure the overall program is aligned to and directly supports the achievement of strategic objectives. Financial Management: Oversee project budgets, track expenditures, and ensure financial objectives are met. Provide regular financial reports and forecasts to stakeholders. Project Monitoring & Control: Prepare estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project. Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources. Transparency and Reporting: Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks & issues, communicating across leadership. Agile Practices: Organize and facilitate release planning, daily stand-up meetings, and reviews. Track and communicate scrum metrics including team velocity and sprint/release progress. Quality Management: Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution. Risk Management: Identify and manage project risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans Experience and Skills: Experience in Agile & Waterfall methodologies. Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and interpersonal skills. Experience in successfully leading projects and programs to from initiation to closure. Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Experience partnering with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams. Flexible with proven ability to conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Flexible work hours when needed to align with counterparts at other Otis locations. Support diverse and inclusive work environment. Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects. Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools. PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between. Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality. Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces. Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution. Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels. Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines. Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge. What You Bring 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them. A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva. Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.). A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience. Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro. Bonus Points Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS). Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing. Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Ai Data Annotation Specialist

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. Must-haves 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end) Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data Plusses Experience with C++ development Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes Day-to-Day You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science, IT, MIS or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 5 years of hands-on project management experience, including initiating, tracking and planning projects. Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, PPM and Agile tools. PMP Certification required. Agile certifications are highly desirable

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description: The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience. About Us Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic. Role This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms. As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality. Responsibilities Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads). Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems. Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics. Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns. Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows. Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions. Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations. Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings. Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources. Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries. Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates. Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates. Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly. Results Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets. Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads). Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status. Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context. Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns. Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation. Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality. Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks. Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation. Requirements Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years. Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively. Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools. Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems. Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns. Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred. Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems. Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs. Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization. Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills. Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information. Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously. The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.
